recreation_brief:
1. Create a blank PowerPoint slide with a white (#FFFFFF) background.
2. Draw a thick red (#FF0000) rectangular border around the entire slide content area, inset slightly from the slide edges.
3. Draw thin blue (#0000FF) internal grid lines to form a 3x3 grid: vertical lines at 35% and 67% of slide width; horizontal lines at 30% and 75% of slide height.
4. Top-left cell (left of the 35% line, above the 30% line): add a red-bordered box with the bold black header 'Threshold=0.0'. Inside, build a 4-row x 3-column table with thin black borders and black text on white: Row 1 = [blank, 'Predicted as' merged across columns 2-3]; Row 2 = ['Actual', 'P', 'N']; Row 3 = ['P', '5', '0']; Row 4 = ['N', '6', '0']. Make 'Predicted as' and 'Actual' bold.
5. Immediately to the right of the Threshold=0.0 table (still inside the left column): add a small red-bordered box with two lines of black text: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=6/(6+0)=1'.
6. Middle-left cell (left of the 35% line, between the 30% and 75% lines): add a red-bordered box with the bold black header 'Threshold=0.1'. Inside, build the same 4-row x 3-column table structure: Row 1 = [blank, 'Predicted as' merged]; Row 2 = ['Actual', 'P', 'N']; Row 3 = ['P', '5', '0']; Row 4 = ['N', '4', '2'].
7. Immediately to the right of the Threshold=0.1 table: add a small red-bordered box with two lines of black text: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66'.
8. From the Threshold=0.1 box area, draw one small black (#000000) arrow pointing toward the bottom-right (toward the ROC plot area).
9. Right column (right of the 67% line, from the top edge down to the 75% line): draw the plot area with a light blue (#E6F3FF) fill, a blue (#0000FF) border, and light grid lines. Place the y-axis label 'TPR' rotated 90 degrees (vertical) along the left side, and the x-axis label 'FPR' centered below the plot, both in black.
10. On the plot, mark exactly two data points, each circled in red (#FF0000) with a black annotation label: point labeled '0.1' at (FPR=0.66, TPR=1.0) in the upper area left of the corner; point labeled '0.0' at (FPR=1.0, TPR=1.0) in the top-right corner of the plot.
11. Bottom-center cell (between the 35% and 67% lines, below the 75% line): add a blue-bordered rectangle with white fill containing the black bold text 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'.
12. Bottom-right cell (right of the 67% line, below the 75% line), upper part: add two small red-bordered boxes, one above the other, containing 'TPR = TP / (TP + FN)' and 'FPR = FP / (FP + TN)' in black text.
13. Directly below the formula boxes: build a 4-row x 3-column legend table with the same header structure (Row 1 = [blank, 'Predicted as' merged]; Row 2 = ['Actual', 'P', 'N']). Fill data cells with text and background colors: cell (P,P) = 'TP' on #CCFFCC; cell (P,N) = 'FN' on #FFCCCC; cell (N,P) = 'FP' on #FFCCCC; cell (N,N) = 'TN' on #CCFFCC; header cells white.
14. At the extreme top-right corner of the slide, add a yellow (#FFD700) filled circle containing the black bold number '30'.
15. Typography: use a black sans-serif font (Arial or Calibri) throughout; bold the box headers ('Threshold=0.0', 'Threshold=0.1', 'Predicted as', 'Actual') and the title box text. Apply no animations.
